heading: Audeohost finds the venue. Audeohost has every event.
subhead: When it comes to Fan live TV sports promotion, Fanzo casts a wider net and is the leader in Out of Home sports-only discovery. Venues offer more without question - but what is it? Audeohost is live with every event you have, whether its Chess in the Garden, French dining Week, or just the TV sport in the bar.

beats.tag: Every event, every night — Audeohost's own turf
beats.title: Marketing up to 30 days out, not just today's discovery
beats.text: Trivia, live music, comedy, and every match on every screen — published up to a month ahead in the same Portal. Fanzo doesn't quite do that: its listings are built around what's on now, not what a fan can plan a night around next month. Not downstream of Fanzo or anyone else, and still there long after the big fixture has passed.

beats.tag: On matchday — where Fanzo hands off
beats.title: The build-up and the analysis, not just the 90 minutes
beats.text: Fanzo can tell a fan which pub has the match; it can't tell them what it'll sound like once they're there. Most bars won't turn the sound up for pre-game build-up, and the moment the final whistle goes, the music comes back — the post-match analysis a lot of fans actually stayed for gets lost. Audeohost's audio doesn't follow the house system's schedule: full pre-game, full match, full analysis, on the fan's own phone, for as long as they want to stay.

beats.tag: From then on — the leaderboard is ours to keep
beats.title: Connect once, stay top of the list
beats.text: A guest who favourites your venue on Audeohost sees it promoted first the next time they're deciding where to go. Fanzo, at best, gets someone through the door once. Audeohost is the source for every event at that venue, from that day forward.

beatStrip: Fanzo's the wider net on sport, today. Audeohost is the whole venue, a month out — and once a fan connects once, the leaderboard remains.
